description: Source code for the Menu class in typeahead.js, a library for building autocomplete/typeahead UI components. Defines the Menu class with methods for handling dataset rendering, user interaction, and visibility control.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Class representing the dropdown menu component in typeahead.js, managing dataset rendering, user interactions, and visibility.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds event handlers for user interactions and dataset events.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the menu is currently open.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the menu and resets scroll position.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the menu and removes cursor.

methods.name: setLanguageDirection
methods.description: Sets the text direction (e.g., 'ltr' or 'rtl') for the menu.

methods.name: selectableRelativeToCursor
methods.description: Returns a selectable element relative to the current cursor position.

methods.name: setCursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor to a specific selectable element.

methods.name: getSelectableData
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a selectable element.

methods.name: getActiveSelectable
methods.description: Returns the currently active (highlighted) selectable element.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the menu with a new query and dataset.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Clears all datasets and resets the menu state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes event handlers and cleans up the menu instance.
